Evidence and publication scope

Only selected-role outputs, original interval endpoints and clocks, public schedule identities, coarse model families and saved aggregate scores appear here. Complete journals, private recipes, parameters, raw provider feeds and model bodies remain private.

Saved retrospective candidate grids do not fill an original-issue gap. Historical evidence remains exposed development. The newest failed execution does not erase or renew earlier forecasts. Source publication, owner execution and website deployment are separate events.

Research-only and non-wagering. This saved report makes no live refresh, automatic promotion, staking or performance guarantee. The official observation can be incomplete; unresolved games remain unresolved.
